faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IISER Bhopal Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IISER Bhopal is 05-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related fields from a recognized Institute or University to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. How will the candidates be selected for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IISER Bhopal will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,000/- per month, along with HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply for this position by sending their application via Email.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal (IISER Bhopal).

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is IISERB/DoFA/2026/23.
